paper_record.title: Spatially dispersive photogalvanic effects as a probe of quantum geometric tensor
paper_record.abstract: Berry curvature and quantum metric of Bloch states govern a wide range of phenomena, yet unified experimental access to both remains limited. Here we show that light spatial-dispersion alters the selection rules of second-order photocurrents and responses forbidden by parity become allowed in centrosymmetric crystals without any external fields, magnetic order, interfaces, strain, or engineered symmetry breaking. The resulting response is intrinsic and its weight is set by the quantum geometry of the Bloch states. Conventional photogalvanic effects are constrained by crystal symmetry and entangle the quantum metric with shift vector contributions. The spatially-dispersive response instead isolates the quantum metric and Berry curvature in distinct polarization channels. Implementing this approach in 1T'-MoTe2 across its temperature-driven transition to Td-Weyl phase, we resolve helicity-even and helicity-odd photocurrents corresponding to quantum metric and Berry curvature contributions, respectively, from the same device. The metric-dominated response persists across both phases and exhibits a robust spectral structure reproduced by first-principles calculations and linked to momentum-resolved quantum metric hotspots. In contrast, the curvature-driven channel emerges only when inversion symmetry is broken and shows strong sensitivity to carrier doping through competing momentum-space contributions. Our results establish photogalvanic effects with spatially varying optical fields as a general route to accessing quantum geometry in materials where photon energy and electronic filling probe different parts of the excitation manifold.

one_sentence_summary.zh: 通过空间色散光电流效应，在无需打破晶体对称性的情况下，实现了对布洛赫态量子几何张量中量子度规和贝里曲率的直接探测。
one_sentence_summary.en: Spatially dispersive photogalvanic effects enable direct experimental access to both the quantum metric and Berry curvature of Bloch states without requiring symmetry breaking.

problem.zh: 传统的非线性光学探测手段受限于晶体对称性，难以在同一器件中同时解耦并独立测量量子度规（对称）和贝里曲率（反对称）。
problem.en: Conventional nonlinear optical probes are constrained by crystal symmetry, making it difficult to disentangle and independently measure the quantum metric and Berry curvature in the same device.

approach.zh: 利用聚焦激光束产生的空间强度梯度（空间色散），打破动量空间的选择定则，通过偏振分辨测量将光电流分解为量子度规主导的线性分量和贝里曲率主导的圆分量。
approach.en: Utilizing spatial intensity gradients of a focused laser beam to lift selection rules, and decomposing the resulting photocurrent into quantum metric-dominated linear and Berry curvature-dominated circular channels via polarization-resolved measurements.

main_takeaway.zh: 空间色散光电流效应是一种普适的探测手段，能够通过偏振选择性地提取量子几何张量的实部（量子度规）和虚部（贝里曲率）。
main_takeaway.en: Spatially dispersive photogalvanic effects provide a universal framework to selectively extract the real (quantum metric) and imaginary (Berry curvature) parts of the quantum geometric tensor.

why_it_matters.zh: 该方法摆脱了对外部磁场或特定晶体对称性的依赖，为研究拓扑半金属、平带系统及莫尔超晶格中的量子几何特性提供了新的实验路径。
why_it_matters.en: This approach removes the reliance on external fields or specific crystal symmetries, offering a new experimental route to study quantum geometry in topological semimetals, flat-band systems, and moiré superlattices.

reason.zh: 该工作提出了一种全新的光学探测协议，成功解决了量子度规在实验上难以独立测量的长期难题。
reason.en: This work introduces a novel optical protocol that successfully resolves the long-standing challenge of independently measuring the quantum metric.

reason.zh: 该研究在量子几何探测领域具有显著的方法论创新，且实验与第一性原理计算吻合度极高。
reason.en: The study presents a significant methodological innovation in quantum geometry probing with excellent agreement between experiment and first-principles calculations.
